facts.text: I am a beginner at hiking.
I have been doing some walking with my partner on the weekends.

I want to invite my partner to join me on hikes.
I think it would be helpful to discuss our goals and expectations with my partner beforehand.
I plan to have a conversation with my partner this weekend about our goals and expectations for hiking together.
I want recommendations for hiking apps or tools to track our progress and stay motivated.
